title: The c0mpute roadmap
subtitle: Building the torrent for compute
disclaimer: This roadmap reflects current direction, not a promise of dates. Items move as the network and its priorities evolve.
footnote: *Shipped = live today, verifiable on-chain, in the app, or in published receipts. Everything else is direction, not dates.
howto: This is an interactive visual; zoom in and pan around with your mouse to explore. Hover over a component for more detail.

tracks.name: Network
tracks.tagline: Permissionless GPU supply. Anyone with a GPU joins, earns, and scales the network.

items.title: Permissionless workers
items.blurb: Anyone can connect a GPU and start earning per job. No allowlist, no approval step.

items.title: Worker payouts
items.blurb: USDC earnings with self-serve withdrawals for every worker on the network.

items.title: Browser workers
items.blurb: A spare laptop earns too: WebGPU workers serve smaller models straight from a browser tab. No install.

items.title: Anti-cheat canaries
items.blurb: Probe jobs continuously verify that workers return honest output.

items.title: Swarm as a worker
items.blurb: Many scattered GPUs serve one big model together and register as a single worker, earning on real jobs.

items.title: Self-managing swarms
items.blurb: Swarms fit themselves to whatever GPUs join, reorder around latency, and survive a node dying mid-job. Failover is already demonstrated.

items.title: One-command swarm join
items.blurb: A GPU behind a home router joins a swarm with one command. No port forwarding, no manual setup, only its assigned block of the model.

items.title: Per-GPU identity and pay
items.blurb: Each GPU in a swarm joins with its own identity and earns its own balance for the tokens it helped produce.

items.title: The c0mpute network
items.blurb: The endgame: every GPU on earth can join, serve and train any model, and earn for every token it helps produce. One permissionless network: the torrent for compute.

items.title: WAN sharded inference
items.blurb: Frontier-size models split across scattered GPUs over the public internet, proven from 120B on consumer cards up to 744B.

items.title: Speculative decoding
items.blurb: A draft-verify loop that multiplies tokens per network round trip. The trick that makes WAN inference usable.

items.title: Signed receipts
items.blurb: Every job emits a verifiable, signed receipt anyone can check.

items.title: Betanet PoC
items.blurb: A model too big for any one GPU, sharded across scattered consumer GPUs and serving real jobs end to end. The proof the whole approach is real.

items.title: Any-model runtime
items.blurb: One runtime interface so the network serves any model, not a hand-ported architecture. A new model onboards with no engine changes.

items.title: Ever-bigger models
items.blurb: A catalog of models, each sharded across a swarm sized to its needs. The network stops being bound by any single machine.

items.title: Distributed training
items.blurb: The same rails carry training: identity, transport, verified work, payment. A new execution core on proven infrastructure.

items.title: Trustless verification
items.blurb: Catch a node that returns plausible garbage instead of doing its work, and slash its stake. The hard research problem.

items.title: Private inference
items.blurb: Sensitive layers pinned to staked nodes, and trusted-nodes-only routing for sensitive jobs. Privacy that is earned, not claimed.

tracks.name: $ZERO
tracks.tagline: The token economy. Network usage funds on-chain buybacks and staking rewards.

items.title: Buyback & burn
items.blurb: Daily on-chain buybacks funded by real network usage.

items.title: Auto-compound
items.blurb: Opt in and daily USDC rewards buy $ZERO and restake into your own vault automatically.

items.title: Self-custody staking
items.blurb: Stake from your own wallet through an on-chain program. No server key can touch your tokens. Rewards paid in USDC.

items.title: Daily staking allowance
items.blurb: Stakers draw a free daily inference allowance, pro-rata to their stake, on top of USDC rewards. Chat, API and images all draw from it.

items.title: Referrals
items.blurb: A share of referred usage, paid out in USDC.

items.title: Non-custodial payments
items.blurb: Wallet-signed top-ups and pull-claim payouts replace the last server-held rails. Staking already made the move.

items.title: Keyless vaults
items.blurb: User-paying funds live in program vaults with no private key, and upgrade keys get burned. No one can freeze funds or stop a claim.

items.title: Trustless payouts
items.blurb: Worker and staker payouts anchored to on-chain proof of the compute itself, so no one has to be trusted to say who earned what.

tracks.name: Product
tracks.tagline: Uncensored, private inference. Chat, API, images, and beyond.

items.title: Uncensored chat
items.blurb: Uncensored chat with web search, image generation and deep thinking built in. No prompt storage, no account needed to start.

items.title: Image generation
items.blurb: Uncensored image generation in chat and via the API.

items.title: Public API
items.blurb: OpenAI-compatible inference API with flat pricing.

items.title: c0mpute code
items.blurb: An open coding agent in your terminal. Thinking runs on the network; edits and commands run locally, and secrets are stripped before anything is sent.

items.title: Bigger uncensored models
items.blurb: A larger uncensored model for the max tier, already validated on consumer GPUs, being wired into the network now.

items.title: Metered API pricing
items.blurb: Usage-based API pricing so frontier-size swarm models price honestly alongside fast single-GPU tiers.

items.title: Frontier models in chat
items.blurb: Chat and API served by models sharded across the swarm, up to frontier size. The betanet, surfaced in the product.

items.title: Flat monthly plan
items.blurb: One subscription covering chat, API, images and code, built for heavy private use. Pay once, prompt freely.
